notes.title: First Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Here is our first major update. We still have a lot of work ahead, but we’ve already accomplished a lot:

1. Modes

Completely redesigned: after you level up in the first mode, all upgrades are saved and become available in the “Challenge” mode.
The “Challenge” mode currently uses temporary enemy spawn logic, but we’ll radically overhaul it soon.

2. Leaderboards

Steam integration: your account nickname is pulled automatically — no more manual entry required.

3. UI

Updated interface — this is still a temporary version. A full redesign is on the way, so don’t be surprised when you see a brand-new look.

4. Localization

English version added. You can now choose between Russian and English in the settings.

5. Bug Fixes & Mechanics

Fixed numerous bugs across various parts of the game.
Added new enemy spawn mechanics: the wave sequence and internal wave logic have been updated.


What’s next?

Preparing a major overhaul of the “Challenge” mode with a new enemy spawn system.
Continuing to improve the UI, balance, and game mechanics based on your feedback.

Thanks for helping us make the game better! We look forward to your impressions, suggestions, and any bugs you find. Enjoy the game! 🎉
